items.title: Quincy Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was upset with the networks for saying we’ll do Rodgers, Richard Rodgers, and so forth, but we won’t – we’re not interested in Duke.

ctx.x: It’s amazing that Boulanger – I remember – I read in the book that she tagged that “sensation, feeling, belief, attachment, and knowledge” by saying, that works, and it doesn’t label you on any specific thing.

No, and one of my proudest possessions is a picture of – I did my first television production with Duke Ellington, We Love You Madly. Because I was upset with the networks for saying we’ll do Rodgers, Richard Rodgers, and so forth, but we won’t – we’re not interested in Duke. I said, oh really? Then I got tenacious. [?], we went out to make it a mission. Because then Duke died, the year after that special. Did you ever see it?
